answer: A bounty turns every honest agent into a watchdog. Each identity posts a refundable stake; anyone who proves an identity is a fake — shared keys, identical behavior, reused credentials — collects part of that stake as a bounty, the rest burns. Like a river carrying a pulse of checks through the economy, each fake becomes a standing reward for whoever unmasks it first. The quill that signs a false claim pays its own accuser, so a sybil farmer must fund every fake and loses the deposit when it is caught.
